biggest_catch: The $5 bonus is only receivable after your Step account is unlocked, and anyone under 18 needs an adult sponsor who also downloads the app and creates their own account before the card can be unlocked - so a teen cannot earn the bonus without a participating parent or guardian.
catches: The $5 bonus is not instant at download - the official page says it is only receivable 'once your account is unlocked'.
Users under 18 cannot unlock the account alone: an adult must download the app and create their own account first.
The $5 figure comes from Step's invite/referral landing pages; the general step.com homepage does not advertise it, so the bonus is tied to joining via an invite link.
Step is a teen-focused account product with no monthly fees stated, but Step gives no stated timeline for bonus payout beyond account unlock.
Small absolute payout: $5 covers little relative to any effort beyond a few minutes of signup.
